message: Last summer, we had an unexpected blackout while I was making dinner. The kids freaked out at first, but I quickly grabbed our trusty flashlights and turned it into a little adventure! We ended up having a ‘candlelight’ dinner with lanterns and power banks keeping our phones charged for games. It taught me that a little creativity goes a long way in keeping things lighthearted, even when the lights go out! Have you had a fun blackout moment with your family? I'd love to hear your tips!
